gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-mandaic: College gives every curve the weight of a straight stem, while Noto Sans Mandaic lets its lowercase climb near the capitals. College is at its best big and short, just a word or two.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-marchen: Noto Sans Marchen reads clean, its small letters standing proud and its curves ending in clear daylight. College, drawn as a ribbon of constant width, lets paragraphs of the body flow without snagging.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-mayan-nu: Flat, bold, unfussy: College keeps every line weight alike, while Noto Sans Mayan Numerals has small letters with a visibly gaping c. The standout quality is that unvarying line.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-mende-ki: College's diagonals match its stems in weight, a blunt, authoritative punch. Noto Sans Mende Kikakui sits beside it modern and clean, with daylight showing through every curve it draws.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-meroitic: Sturdy and unfussy, College matches every diagonal to the weight of its stems. And Noto Sans Meroitic, with see-through c openings, fills each line like capitals, making longer text feel approachable.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-modi: Modern in spirit, College draws every stroke with no contrast at all. Noto Sans Modi brings daylight inside every curve and a small gap between capital and body height, which keeps paragraphs moving smoothly.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-mono: Noto Sans Mono spaces its letters generously so nothing bumps, and its large lowercase makes words look sturdy. Noto Sans Mono sits comfortably at modest sizes, leaving College's true monoline heading to go large.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-mro: Blunt and confident, College runs strokes free of contrast from stem to terminal. And Noto Sans Mro, dense through the middle with generous entrances into each letter, keeps text feeling sturdy line after line.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-multani: Authoritative and dynamic, College draws with compass-pencil consistency, while Noto Sans Multani lifts its x-height and opens the e wide. Long paragraphs in it read lofty and unhurried, never crowded.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-myanmar: Solid and sign-bold: College holds one constant line with no flicker, while Noto Sans Myanmar lays a heavy-looking strip through the middle. Let College go large and give Noto Sans Myanmar a modest size.
